items.source:
Such manual mapping is usually preferable to "automatic"
mapping using reflection, which can become complex in non-trivial
cases. For example, the present class allows different objects
to be used for different rows (for example, if a subclass is indicated).
It allows computed fields to be set. And there's no need for
ResultSet columns to have the same names as bean properties.
The Pareto Principle in action: going the extra mile to automate
the extraction process makes the framework much more complex
and delivers little real benefit.
items.translation: 这种手动映射通常优于使用反射的“自动”映射，因为在非平凡的情况下，后者可能会变得复杂。例如，当前类允许为不同的行使用不同的对象（例如，如果指定了子类）。它允许设置计算字段。而且，不需要 ResultSet 列名与 Bean 属性名称相同。帕累托原则在此发挥作用：为了自动化提取过程而付出额外努力会使框架变得更为复杂，却几乎没有带来真正的收益。

items.source:
Subclasses can be constructed providing SQL, parameter types
and a DataSource. SQL will often vary between subclasses.
items.translation: 子类可以通过提供 SQL、参数类型和 DataSource 来构建。SQL 在不同子类之间通常会有所不同。

items.source: Constructor to allow use as a JavaBean.
items.translation: 构造函数，允许用作 JavaBean。

items.source: Convenient constructor with DataSource and SQL string.
items.translation: 带有 DataSource 和 SQL 字符串的便捷构造函数。

items.source:
Subclasses must implement this method to convert each row
of the ResultSet into an object of the result type.
items.translation: 子类必须实现此方法，将 ResultSet 的每一行转换为结果类型的对象。

items.source:
Implementation of protected abstract method. This invokes the subclass's
implementation of the mapRow() method.
items.translation: 受保护的抽象方法的实现。这会调用子类对 `mapRow()` 方法的实现。

items.source: newRowMapper in class SqlQuery<T extends @Nullable Object>
items.translation: `newRowMapper` 在类 `SqlQuery<T extends @Nullable Object>` 中。

items.source: ds - the DataSource to use to get connections
items.translation: ds - 用于获取连接的 DataSource

items.source: Implementation of RowMapper that calls the enclosing class's mapRow method for each row.
items.translation: 实现调用外围类的mapRow方法的每一行的 RowMapper。

items.source: Implementation of protected abstract method.
items.translation: 受保护的抽象方法的实现。

items.source: parameters - the parameters to the execute() method, in case subclass is interested; may be null if there were no parameters.
items.translation: parameters - 传递给 execute() 方法的参数，子类感兴趣时使用；如果没有参数，则可能为 null。

items.source: T - the result type
items.translation: T - 结果类型

items.source: context - the contextual information passed to the mapRow callback method. The JDBC operation itself doesn't rely on this parameter, but it can be useful for creating the objects of the result list.
items.translation: context - 传递给 mapRow 回调方法的上下文信息。JDBC 操作本身不依赖此参数，但它在创建结果列表中的对象时可能很有用。

items.source: parameters - to the query (passed to the execute() method). Subclasses are rarely interested in these. It can be null if there are no parameters.
items.translation: `parameters` - 到查询中（传递给 execute() 方法）。子类很少对这些感兴趣。如果没有参数，它可以为 `null`。

items.source: context - passed to the execute() method. It can be null if no contextual information is need.
items.translation: context - 传递给 execute() 方法。如果不需要上下文信息，它可以为 null。

items.source: SQLException - if there's an error extracting data. Subclasses can simply not catch SQLExceptions, relying on the framework to clean up.
items.translation: SQLException - 如果提取数据时出现错误。子类可以简单地不捕获 SQLException，依赖框架进行清理。

items.source: sql - the SQL to run
items.translation: sql - 要执行的 SQL

items.source: rs - the ResultSet we're working through
items.translation: rs - 我们正在遍历的结果集

items.source: rowNum - row number (from 0) we're up to
items.translation: rowNum - 当前所在的行号（从 0 开始）

items.translation: Rod Johnson、Thomas Risberg 和 Jean-Pierre Pawlak
